pr_title: GameEngine: add reproducible local LLM benchmark experiments
pr_body:
## Summary

Builds a reproducible GameEngine Agent Benchmark runner for arbitrary discovered/exact local models. Experiments freeze exact identity and reset repository-owned fixtures per run. The native runtime now exposes a benchmark-only exact-model turn entry that bypasses ADR0150 specialist selection and fallback, including for image input, so single-model attribution cannot be contaminated.

Further commits on this Draft PR wire child-Editor scenario execution and AI Studio suite controls for all seven ADR0142 tasks.
